build: R5Flowstate S21 client + S3 dedicated server + SDK, local offline, 120 fps, Gibraltar

params.name: find_cone_half_angle_bracket_deg
params.unit: deg (largest mounted, smallest refused rule angle)
params.note: standing ground presses; angle between the eye direction and the min-angle rope point within 130 u of origin+72 (M6-A3 rule); failures below the largest success: 0; M6-A3 bracket was 27.0-40.7

params.name: find_collector_distance_bracket
params.unit: u, origin+72 -> nearest rope point (largest mounted, smallest refused)
params.note: consistent with the 120 u candidate collector (SDK comment); the 130 u point search radius of M6-A3 still fits every grip point

params.name: grip_point
params.value: = the M6-A3 min-angle rope point (within 130 u of origin+72) at any position along the rope, incl. mid-rope and at the anchors
params.note: see analysis_output §3 grip - rule residual

params.name: ride_direction_rule
params.value: sign(eye . rope_dir): > 0 -> toward the rope end, <= 0 (incl. exactly 0) -> toward the start; dedi reverse flag = 1 for the start direction
params.note: dot>0: {'fwd': 240, 'rev': 5, 'None': 25, 'up': 10}; dot<0: {'fwd': 15, 'rev': 55, 'None': 10}; dot=0: {'rev': 39, 'fwd': 9, 'up': 30, 'None': 10} (ends excepted, see end_zone)

params.name: end_zone_reverse
params.note: a grip within ~90 u (between 70 and 110) of the end the view points to rides away from it; just outside, the ride reaches the 90 u stop-short at once and auto-detaches at 600 (no end refusal in R5)

params.name: ground_entry_speed_along_rope
params.note: running / sliding along the rope: the speed along the rope is kept as the mount-state floor (the M6-G grapple rule); 0.5 s later the normal +400 u/s^2 to 600

params.name: mount_crouch_view0
params.note: rule angle [26.52, 26.52]; crouched (and sliding) the reach with a level view is shorter [cause unknown]

params.name: mount_crouch_view_up45
params.note: rule angle [0.0, 0.0]; crouched (and sliding) the reach with a level view is shorter [cause unknown]

params.name: mount_slide_view0
params.note: rule angle [26.49, 26.53]; crouched (and sliding) the reach with a level view is shorter [cause unknown]

params.name: mount_slide_view_up45
params.note: rule angle [0.01, 0.06]; crouched (and sliding) the reach with a level view is shorter [cause unknown]

params.name: air_mount
params.note: standing jump under / 20-80 u beside the rope, view 0-80 deg off, use at the apex / rising / held; same Find rule; Mid Air Interact works in this build

params.name: air_mount_height_gate
params.value: none: mounted with origin+72 from 14.6 below to 26.8 above the rope
params.note: M6-A3 'rope must be above P' hypothesis rejected

params.name: remount_lockout_after_detach_s
params.note: refused before Zipline_Use on the client (no diag line on either side): a native S21-client gate, independent of height; wiki useZiplineCooldown 0.4

params.name: regrab_ladder
params.value: ground mount, then 2 air re-grabs (client cd 0.1 -> 0.2 -> 1.0 s); the 3rd air re-grab 0.42 s after detach is refused; landing resets (cd 0.1, SDK left=3)
params.note: the S21 client cooldown (1.0 s after the 3rd grant) and the SDK hop-regrab count (3, 'latest Apex') refuse together here; the 3 s refill was not tested

params.name: super_jump_k12
params.note: jump-off on the command after the mount, second press K commands later

params.name: super_jump_k18
params.note: jump-off on the command after the mount, second press K commands later

params.name: super_jump_k24
params.note: jump-off on the command after the mount, second press K commands later

params.name: super_jump_k30
params.note: jump-off on the command after the mount, second press K commands later

params.name: lurch_after_jumpoff
params.unit: |dv| u/s on the D press 3 cmds after the jump-off
params.note: AirAccelerate only (4.17 = 500 dt): a zipline jump-off does not open the lurch window

params.name: carry_j1
params.note: run across the rope (+Y, ~285 u/s), use, jump on the next command (j1) / 2 commands later (j3)

params.name: carry_j3
params.note: run across the rope (+Y, ~285 u/s), use, jump on the next command (j1) / 2 commands later (j3)

params.name: direction_locked_during_ride
params.note: a 180 deg view turn after the mount state does not reverse the ride

params.name: vertical_mid_up
params.note: vertical rope (CreateZipline, |dir.z|>0.7)

params.name: vertical_mid_level
params.note: vertical rope (CreateZipline, |dir.z|>0.7)

params.note: vertical rope (CreateZipline, |dir.z|>0.7)
